name: Webhook
author: NetMaster
description: Sends NetMaster's alerts to another system as they happen: ticket and on-call systems (ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Jira), automation (n8n, Power Automate, Zapier, Home Assistant) or chat (Microsoft Teams, Slack, Discord).

settings.label: Webhook address
settings.help: The address the other system gave you, starting with https://. In Teams: the channel's ⋯ → Workflows → "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received".

options.label: NetMaster JSON (ticket systems, n8n, Power Automate ...)

settings.label: Authorization header (optional)
settings.help: Sent as is, e.g. "Bearer abc123" or "Basic ...", for receivers that need a login.

settings.label: Signing secret (optional)
settings.help: If set, each request gets the header X-NetMaster-Signature: sha256=<HMAC of the body>, so the receiver can check that it came from NetMaster.

settings.label: Check the receiver's certificate
settings.help: Turn off only for a receiver in your own network with a self-signed certificate.

actions.label: Send a test
actions.help: Sends a test message with the current settings. Save first.
